title: logs.push result
description: companion → plugin, the payload of the `result` answering a `logs.push`. The two levels are the EFFECTIVE floors the plugin must apply from now on; `busy` and `disabled` are answers, not failures.

dropped.description: Lines below a floor, or not kept because shipping is off.

disabled.description: Shipping is off — on this machine or for this agent. Drop what is queued and ask again after retryAfterSeconds.

busy.description: Another logs.push from this plugin is still being handled; nothing was kept. Send again on the next tick.
